jobInfo.jobDescription:
Thank you for considering employment in the Lunenburg Public Schools.
The mission of The Lunenburg Public Schools is to provide all students with the skills, confidence, and passion for life-long learning so that they may find their own paths to successful careers, active citizenship, and rewarding lives.

There is an open part time custodial position at the Lunenburg Public Schools.

TITLE:  Custodian
REPORTS TO: Senior Custodian

DUTIES & REPSONSIBILITIES:
Lunenburg Public Schools seeks a motivated individual to serve as part-time evening custodian.
This individual would be responsible for cleaning classrooms, restrooms, and hallways between 6:00 PM and 9:30 PM Monday to Friday. 
Part-time evening custodian also would be responsible for maintaining the school physical plant in a condition of operating excellence so that full educational use of it is available at all times. 
Work includes sweeping, vacuuming, mopping, finishing floors, cleaning and disinfecting restroom fixtures and floors, cleaning walls, desks, and windows as required as well as emptying trash receptacles/disposing of trash and securing windows and doors.   
The part-time evening custodians will assist with snow removal as needed. 

EXPERIENCE
Previous experience plus the ability/skill to do minor repairs preferred, but not required.  

OTHER
Some flexibility with the starting time may be possible.

SALARY:  Salary and benefits per Lunenburg Custodial contract.
jobInfo.requirements:
OTHER
Citizenship, residency or work visa required.

Hiring is subject to satisfactory CORI and SAFIS Background Checks per 603 CMR 51.
